entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can't waste any time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We gotta hurry up and go to that world[n]and beat the shit outta that asshole!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...We're not beating him up. We're simply[n]stealing his distorted desires.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Can I assume that you've made up your[n]minds about this—about how he might[n]suffer a mental shutdown?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I have.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Someone almost died because of him![n]I don't give a rat's ass what happens to[n]him anymore!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And you?
I agree.
There's no other way.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Then it's settled.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There you have it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the way, is gettin' rid of a Palace hard?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You've tried it before, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...When did I ever say that?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: WHAT!? Were you just pretendin'[n]to know!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is it true that you're getting expelled?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Everyone's talking about it...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That asshole's at it again!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So you came all this way to tell us that?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If you're going to deal with Kamoshida...[n]let me in on it too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can't just sit back and do nothing after[n]what happened to Shiho!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This has nothing to do with you...[n]Don't butt your head into this...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But it does! Shiho's my—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I said don't get in our way!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...That was harsh.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can't take her somewhere like that...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I hope she doesn't do anything too crazy.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Women can be much bolder than men[n]at times.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We just gotta hurry up and deal with[n]Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's go already!
